reviews.title: No trial immediate charge!
reviews.text: This app seemingly is great as for the 20 minutes of use I got out of it for a 3 day trial period before the app starting charging every single card in my digital wallet the full price, repeatedly froze the app, and continued with pop up notifications for a payment despite my never having even downloaded the app before and hadn't even finalized playing around with one photo into one project. Extremely frustrating, annoying and problematic. I do not recommend even slightly.

reviews.title: Works, but don’t pay £19 for it
Paywall & Bad Product
reviews.text: I paid the $19.99 fee to use the app (which is a ridiculous price point to begin with, considering all it really does is chop up an image) because I was in a time pinch and needed a wide image split into two seamless portrait images. It’s simple to use and works quickly—however, it leaves black borders on the split images, defeating the purpose of the app entirely. Should’ve read more reviews before dropping $20, but that’s my fault I suppose. Don’t recommend, unless you’re cool with that bug(?). There are better tools out there.
